Hello! #introduction

ScottiCAD is a free, open-source 3D CAD program for makers and 3D printing. Drag shapes together, cut holes, group them and export for printing, or script it in a Python-like language, or let an AI agent build with it over MCP.

This is a 40:1 planetary gearbox designed in it. It prints in one piece, already assembled, with no supports.

Windows and Linux, Apache-2.0: https://scotticad.com

#3DPrinting #OpenSource #FOSS #CAD
